brief: NallaBox is an iOS party-game app: one Apple device drives the TV, and every guest plays from their phone by scanning a QR code, with no download and no account. The logo should feel playful, social, instant and a little mischievous, and avoid party-game clichés like gamepads, dice, confetti and neon.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px as a favicon and app icon, works in one colour, stands apart from gamepad and neon party-game marks.

concepts.name: Finder Face
concepts.idea: A QR-code eye that winks: scan to join, then bluff your friends.
rationale: The eye is a QR finder square, the app's zero-install join
The wink carries the bluffing and hidden-role games; the smile keeps it friendly
The wordmark's square o repeats the box; one coral, one ink

recommendation: Finder Face in Nalla Coral and Night Ink: the app icon is the logo, and the face can animate (wink, blink, grin) across the games.
next_steps: Run a professional trademark search on the name and mark
Animate the wink for the app launch and lobby
Extend the face into reaction stickers for in-game moments
